caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned at an angle so that both its side and front are visible. The chair has a light to medium brown color, with the wood grain texture lightly indicated. The design includes a ladder-style back with three horizontal slats and two vertical posts that extend above the uppermost slat. The armrests are curved and connect to the front legs, which are joined to the back legs by multiple horizontal stretchers and diagonal supports. The seat is flat and rectangular, and the chair is supported by two curved rockers attached to the bottom of the legs. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details.
title: Rocker
